The Moon had a late-night date with Jupiter.

Overnight the Sun made a friendly trine to Saturn and the Moon met Jupiter in Leo. She moves into Virgo this morning and meets Mars around lunchtime. Swipe for Aries, Leo and Sagittarius, plus one question to journal on today.

Save this for tonight, or send it to your Fire friend. 🌙
